text: Most of Oman features a **desert landscape** with little vegetation. While the middle and southern half is mostly flat, the north coast features dry mountains similar to those found in the UAE. The southern coast also has mountains, though less dry.
text_zh: 阿曼大部分地區呈現植被稀少的**沙漠景觀**。雖然中部和南部半部大多平坦，但北海岸有著類似阿拉伯聯合大公國的乾燥山脈。南海岸也有山脈，但較不乾燥。

text: The Omani Google car drivers covered a lot of small tracks in the middle of the Omani desert.
text_zh: 阿曼的 Google 車駕駛拍攝了阿曼沙漠中許多的小路。

text: Licence plates on private vehicles are generally yellow, while commercial vehicles have red plates.
text_zh: 私人車輛的車牌通常是黃色的，而商業車輛則是紅色的。

text: The coverage in Oman was taken with a white pickup truck. In most locations, the truck is fully blurred out, however you may sometimes see the antenna or the front of the car.
text_zh: 阿曼的街景覆蓋是由一台白色皮卡車拍攝的。在大多數地點，車子都完全被模糊處理，但有時你可能會看到天線或車頭。

text: The official language in Oman is **Arabic**.
NOTE: Due to high tourism, signs in Oman often have English writing alongside Arabic. The same also applies to the UAE.
text_zh: 阿曼的官方語言是**阿拉伯文**。
注意：由於觀光業發達，阿曼的標誌上經常有英文與阿拉伯文並列。阿拉伯聯合大公國也是如此。

text: Roads in Oman use **yellow outer** and **white middle lines.**
NOTE: This is also common in the UAE, Israel, Jordan, as well as occasionally found in Qatar.
text_zh: 阿曼的道路使用**黃色外側**與**白色中間標線**。
注意：這在阿拉伯聯合大公國、以色列、約旦也很常見，偶爾也會在卡達發現。

text: **Black-and-yellow curbs** are common in Oman.
NOTE: The UAE also commonly uses similar curbs.
text_zh: 阿曼常見**黑黃相間的路緣**。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國也很常見類似的路緣。

text: Buildings in Oman are typically made of** light-coloured stone**. The houses are **‘blocky’ **but still quite **ornate**, and they are usually surrounded by a matching fence, which often has an even more ornate gate.
NOTE: Buildings in the UAE are often very similar.
text_zh: 阿曼的建築通常由**淺色石材**建成。房屋呈**「方塊狀」**但仍相當**華麗**，周圍通常環繞著相匹配的圍欄，圍欄通常有更華麗的大門。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國的建築通常非常相似。

text: Directional signs are** blue with white text** and are usually in **Arabic and English**.
NOTE: The UAE and Qatar use similar signs.
text_zh: 方向指示牌為**藍底白字**，通常使用**阿拉伯文與英文**。
注意：阿拉伯聯合大公國與卡達使用類似的標誌。

text: Many signposts in Oman have **black-and-white stripes**.
NOTE: Within the Middle East, striped signposts are only found in Oman and the UAE.
text_zh: 阿曼的許多路標柱帶有**黑白條紋**。
注意：在中東地區，只有阿曼和阿拉伯聯合大公國能找到帶條紋的路標柱。

text: Oman typically uses wooden poles, which have pole tops consisting of three varying designs. The first two have 3 insulators, symmetrically attached to a horizontal metal bar. The design with the [metal triangle above the wooden pole](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iQkF9QogKvu641R2A) is unique to Oman. The third design has the [insulators attached to the side](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V2Ziykrp3nrm2k1b7). Poles in general are more common in Oman than in the UAE or Qatar.
text_zh: 阿曼通常使用木製電線桿，其桿頂由三種不同的設計組成。前兩種有 3 個絕緣子，對稱地固定在水平金屬桿上。[木製電線桿上方有金屬三角形](https://maps.app.goo.gl/iQkF9QogKvu641R2A)的設計是阿曼特有的。第三種設計則是將[絕緣子固定在側面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/V2Ziykrp3nrm2k1b7)。整體而言，電線桿在阿曼比在阿拉伯聯合大公國或卡達更常見。

text: Oman uses **black-and-yellow **chevrons that have an unusually large number of arrows.
text_zh: 阿曼使用**黑黃相間的**轉彎標誌，上面有數量異常多的箭頭。

text: High voltage pylons painted with a red and white pattern are common in Oman.
NOTE: Within the Middle East, red and white painted pylons can also less commonly be found in [Qatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mgn1HPR1K2dP6zwp8).
text_zh: 塗有紅白相間圖案的高壓電塔在阿曼非常常見。
注意：在中東地區，紅白相間的電塔在[卡達](https://maps.app.goo.gl/mgn1HPR1K2dP6zwp8)也較少見。

text: The vast majority of garbage bins in Oman are either black and made of plastic or metallic and grey, with a** three-leaf logo** and the text **‘be’ah’** below it.
NOTE: Garbage bins in [the UAE](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GaydqmWgcZEWEULK6) will occasionally have the text “bee’ah”, with two E’s. The bins are often more colourful too.
text_zh: 阿曼絕大多數的垃圾桶都是黑色的塑膠材質，或是金屬製的灰色垃圾桶，上面有**三葉標誌**，下方則有 **‘be’ah’** 字樣。
注意：[阿拉伯聯合大公國](https://maps.app.goo.gl/GaydqmWgcZEWEULK6)的垃圾桶偶爾會出現「bee’ah」字樣，有兩個 e。這些垃圾桶通常也色彩較豐富。

text: Oman uses white taxis, which have orange-coloured panels on each side.
text_zh: 阿曼使用白色計程車，車身兩側配有橘色飾板。

text: Northern Oman features a **dry mountainous landscape** similar to eastern UAE. The south coast of Oman also rarely features some similar mountains.
text_zh: 阿曼北部具有**乾燥的山地景觀**，類似阿拉伯聯合大公國東部。阿曼南部的海岸也偶爾會出現類似的山脈。

text: Close to the southern coast, especially around Salalah, you will find a **rolling hills landscape**. The area commonly features [rocky ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78), [bushes and small trees](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA) as well as some fairly [green valleys](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A).
text_zh: 靠近南部海岸的地方，特別是在薩拉alah（Salalah）周邊，你會看到**起伏的丘陵景觀**。該地區常見[岩石地面](https://maps.app.goo.gl/jScfBdQjFMYqeLA78)、[灌木和小樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dHACRg4JwejDadmeA)，以及一些相當[翠綠的山谷](https://maps.app.goo.gl/tPNC9mp6zLwKW4d1A)。

text: The mountains north of Nizwa have an amount of **green bushes** that are unusually large for the north. The mountains are very rocky and jagged, which differentiates them from the more [rolling mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NpBXUgtm7496CeuE6) in the south.
text_zh: 尼茲瓦（Nizwa）以北的山脈擁有以北部標準來看數量異常多的**綠色灌木**。這些山脈非常多岩石且崎嶇，這點與南部較為[起伏的山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/NpBXUgtm7496CeuE6)有所區別。

text: Sandy desert with light coloured green and yellow shrubs can be found in northeastern Oman, mainly south and west of Bidiyah.
text_zh: 東北部阿曼可以找到長有淺綠色和黃色灌木的沙質沙漠，主要位於比迪亞（Bidiyah）以南和以西。

text: South of Bidiyah you can find a couple of dirt roads going through a slightly rolling landscape consisting of orange-pink sand and small yellow-ish shrubs. The roads mainly go between long and low sand dunes with a general south-south-west direction.
text_zh: 在比迪亞以南，你可以找到幾條泥土路穿過微幅起伏的景觀，由橘粉色的沙子和黃色小灌木組成。這些道路主要穿梭於長而低矮的沙丘之間，大致呈南南西走向。

text: Salalah is located on a flat coastal plain with rolling mountains surrounding it to the north.
text_zh: 薩拉拉位於平坦的海岸平原上，其北部環繞著起伏的山脈。

text: Masirah Island features a dry and slightly hilly landscape, typically with somewhat grey soil and with [brown shrubs](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9) visible. Road 51, which circulates the island, usually only has a white centre road line, which can help in recognising it. The front camera on the island is [slightly smudged](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7).
text_zh: 馬西拉島的特色是乾燥且有些起伏的地形，土壤通常呈灰灰色，並可見[棕色灌木](https://maps.app.goo.gl/aKFc2E3KJdkTpbxm9)。環島的 51 號公路通常只有白色中央道路標線，這有助於辨識。島上的前鏡頭[有點模糊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/ANPz9Zyhb9M2dsdx7)。

text: **Acacia trees**, recognisable by their relatively short height and umbrella-like flat crowns, are most abundant and common in northern Oman, but can also be found close to the rest of the coast.
text_zh: 以相對矮小且有如傘狀平坦樹冠為特徵的**金合歡樹**，在阿曼北部最為豐富和常見，但在其餘海岸線附近也能找到。

text: **Date palm plantations** are most common along the northern coast.
NOTE: Coconut palms, on the other hand, are usually found near Salalah.
text_zh: **椰棗種植園**在北部海岸最為常見。
注意：另一方面，椰子樹通常分佈在薩拉拉附近。

text: **Sandy dunes**, that usually look quite **red**, are found near the border with Saudi Arabia and further inland in the middle of Oman.
text_zh: 通常看起來相當**紅**的**沙丘**，可以在鄰近沙烏地阿拉伯的邊境以及阿曼中部的內陸深處找到。

text: **Gas pipelines**, often paralleling the road, are most common around Fahud, in Ad Dhahirah Governorate. But they can also be found in many pockets in central-southern Oman.
text_zh: 通常與道路平行的**輸氣管**在內政省（Ad Dhahirah Governorate）法胡德（Fahud）周邊最為常見。但它們也可以在阿曼中南部的許多區域中找到。

text: You can use the colour of the bins in Oman to narrow down your location. The purple regions are mixed.
NOTE: Even the dark blue and red regions are not 100% a certain colour.
text_zh: 你可以利用阿曼垃圾桶的顏色來縮小你的位置範圍。紫色區域是混合區。
注意：即使是深藍色和紅色區域，也不是 100% 確定一定是該顏色。

text: Many bins have a set of numbers on them that can be used to always get the region.
The first pair of numbers give away the governorate, and the second pair further divide the governorates into smaller subdivisions.
NOTE: This map does not list every regional code.
text_zh: 許多垃圾桶上都有一組數字，可用於隨時判定該地區。
第一組數字透露出省份，第二組數字則進一步將省份劃分為更小的細分區域。
注意：此地圖並未列出每一個地區代碼。

text: Black bins with a black sticker on the front can be found in Al Buraimi, Ash Sharqiyah North, and Muscat Governorates.
text_zh: 正面有黑色貼紙的黑色垃圾桶可以在布賴米省、北沙奇雅省和馬斯開特省找到。

text: Grey bins with a black sticker on the front are found in Ad Dhahirah Governorate.
text_zh: 正面有黑色貼紙的灰色垃圾桶可在扎希拉省找到。

text: Black bins with a white sticker are found in Ad Dakhiliyah Governorate, southern Dhofar Governorate, and Muscat Governorate.
text_zh: 正面有白色貼紙的黑色垃圾桶可在內陸省、南部佐法爾省和馬斯開特省找到。

text: Grey bins with a white sticker are commonly found in Ad Dakhiliyah Governorate, and sometimes in Dhofar Governorate.
text_zh: 正面有白色貼紙的灰色垃圾桶常見於內陸省，有時也會在佐法爾省找到。

text: Black bins without stickers are mainly found in Al Batinah South Governorate and north of Al Khaburah in Al Batinah North Governorate.
NOTE: Black bins throughout Oman may appear like they lack stickers, so use this with caution.
text_zh: 沒有貼紙的黑色垃圾桶主要分佈在南巴提納省以及北巴提納省卡布拉以北地區。
注意：整個阿曼的黑色垃圾桶看起來都可能缺乏貼紙，因此請謹慎使用此線索。

text: Grey bins without a sticker on the front are found in Al Batinah North Governorate.
NOTE: They can have a sticker on the side.
text_zh: 正面沒有貼紙的灰色垃圾桶可在北巴提納省找到。
注意：它們的側面可能貼有貼紙。

text: Western-style small black bins are found in Muscat and eastern Al Batinah North Governorate.
text_zh: 西式小黑垃圾桶可在馬斯開特和北巴提納省東部找到。

text: Bins in Muscat governorate often have white-and-red chevron-like stickers on the sides.
text_zh: 馬斯開特省的垃圾桶側面通常有白紅相間的 chevron 狀貼紙。

text: Regardless of colour, if the bins have a sticker on the side, you should be in one of the North Coast governorates.
text_zh: 無論顏色為何，如果垃圾桶側面有貼紙，你應該就位於北部海岸的省份之一。

text: A **regular-looking antenna** that **faces upwards** is mainly found around and west of Muscat, as well as on highways in the northwest. A few other pockets include [Al Buraimi](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AAPLiRFwg7ZqPhS7A) and [Sohar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nHSFUkLhoNNuKW6L8).
text_zh: 一個**朝上**的**外觀普通的天線**主要分佈在馬斯喀特周邊及西方，以及西北部的公路上。其他少數區域包含[布萊米](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AAPLiRFwg7ZqPhS7A)和[蘇哈爾](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nHSFUkLhoNNuKW6L8)。

text: A **forwards-facing antenna** is only found in and around Muscat.
text_zh: **朝前的天線**僅在馬斯喀特市內及周邊地區發現。

text: The ridge east of Mirbat is similar to the Salalah ridge, but more **pronounced**, and the terrain just south of it is more** rugged and hilly**.
text_zh: 米爾巴特（Mirbat）東側的山脊與薩拉拉山脊相似，但更加**明顯**，且其正南方的地形更加**崎嶇多山**。

text: A prominent** lone-standing mountain** can be seen from afar just southeast of Nizwa. It is more wide than it is tall, and has a **crown-like shape**.
text_zh: 從奈茲瓦（Nizwa）東南方遠處可以看到一座顯眼的**獨立孤山**。它寬度大於高度，且具有**皇冠般的形狀**。

text: Just north of Adam, you’ll find a flat desert landscape with greyish soil and mountains in the distance, notably [one long ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79) to the south followed by [two smaller and rounder hills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96) to the east and southeast. Other mountains are also visible to the north and west.
text_zh: 就在亞當北方，你會發現平坦的沙漠景觀，土壤呈灰灰色，遠處有山脈，特別是南方有[一道長山脊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/AFDyzLikH9mg41S79)，東方和東南方隨後有[兩座較小且較圓的山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/7DcxmRPv7QrxDJo96)。北方和西方也能看到其他山脈。

text: In and close to Adam, the coverage is usually quite hazy, and the ridge and hills from the previous tip can be seen to the north. Though sometimes, only [one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JF2kVdCibsQo72N27) or [two](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BFpSfW4WPP9ws7sK8) are visible. Unlike north of Adam, you won’t see mountains in any other direction.
text_zh: 在亞當及鄰近地區，街景通常相當朦朧，從前一個提示中提到的山脊和山丘可以在北方看到。不過有時候，只看得到[一個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/JF2kVdCibsQo72N27)或[兩個](https://maps.app.goo.gl/BFpSfW4WPP9ws7sK8)。與亞當以北不同，你在其他任何方向都看不到山脈。

text: Around the town of Ubar, you can find patches of green agricultural land surrounded by desert.
text_zh: 在烏巴爾城鎮周圍，你可以找到被沙漠包圍的綠色農田斑塊。

text: **Oil drills** are common around Amal and sometimes seen along Road 39. As well as northwest of Fahud, in Ad Dhahirah Governorate.
text_zh: **鑽油機**在阿邁勒（Amal）周邊很常見，有時也會沿著 39 號公路看到。另外也位於內政省法胡德的西北方。

text: If you are surrounded by mountains on all sides, and you are in a somewhat urban area, you are likely just southeast of Muscat, in Al Amarat.
text_zh: 如果你的四面八方都被群山環繞，且你身處有點都會感的區域，你很可能就在馬斯開特的東南方，即阿姆拉特。

text: The **bumpy **and **sloped ridge of hills** combined with all the **pipes **and other** oil related infrastructure** makes the town of Fahud very distinct.
text_zh: **顛簸**且**傾斜的山脊**結合了所有的**管線**和其他**石油相關基礎設施**，使得法胡德鎮非常有特色。

text: Musandam governorate has more in common with the UAE than most of Oman, due to the even** drier mountainous landscape**, and it often has an orange tone. [Dipping beds](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7), or mountains with diagonal layers, are common too.
NOTE: Most of mainland Oman is dry but still has [somewhat shrubby mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6).
text_zh: 穆桑代姆省（Musandam governorate）比多數阿曼地區與阿拉伯聯合大公國有更多相似之處，因為這裡有更**乾燥的山區景觀**，且通常帶有橘色調。[傾斜岩層](https://maps.app.goo.gl/WSXnawCd6epZWmCy7)，也就是具有對角線層理的山脈，在這裡也很常見。
注意：阿曼本土大部分地區是乾燥的，但仍有[些許灌木叢生的山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/PDSq6znEJaiB52uy6)。

text: Some of the coverage in the Musandam Governorate exclave is coastal, with rocky cliffs usually hugging the road. A majority, but [not all](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bUp5v4MLE5E3nHdK7), of this coverage will have the coast to the west, excluding any other roads in the country with a similar look.
text_zh: 穆桑代姆省外飛地的部分街景是沿海的，岩石懸崖通常緊鄰道路。此街景的大多數（但[非全部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bUp5v4MLE5E3nHdK7)）海岸都會在西方，這可排除國內其他外觀類似的道路。

text: The road going to Saudi Arabia from Ibri can be recognised by the completely flat desert landscape with bright pink-greyish soil along with the road having** very wide shoulders** and the overall great road condition. The southern portion goes in a straight northeast direction, and the [northern section](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7) curves more and can have more shrubs.
text_zh: 從伊布里（Ibri）通往沙烏地阿拉伯的道路可以透過完全平坦的沙漠景觀來識別，這裡有明亮的粉灰色土壤，且道路擁有**非常寬的路肩**以及整體極佳的道路狀況。南部路段大致朝東北方向筆直延伸，而[北部路段](https://maps.app.goo.gl/DayXLmNREwVVVZpc7)彎道較多，可能會有更多灌木。

text: Similar to the previous road, the road west of Fahud goes through a flat desert with pink-greyish soil. The main difference is that the road itself is in poor shape and without roadlines as well as the direction of the road being southeast.
text_zh: 與前一條道路相似，法胡德西側的道路穿過帶有粉灰色土壤的平坦沙漠。主要的區別在於道路本身狀況不佳、沒有道路標線，且道路方向為東南走向。

text: Road 29 south of Ibri features a fairly shrubby landscape, with low and jagged mountains on the eastern side of the road. The** low-lying sun** to the northwest is particularly distinct.
text_zh: 伊布里南側的 29 號公路具有相當多灌木的景觀，道路東側有低矮且鋸齒狀的山脈。西北方**低垂的太陽**特別明顯。

text: The southern section of Road 29 only has a **middle white line**, which along with the greyish and sandy desert landscape makes this road unique.
text_zh: 29 號公路的南部路段只有一條**中間白線**，這點加上灰白色且沙質的沙漠景觀，使得這條道路非常獨特。

text: This long stretch of Road 31 can be recognised by the light-coloured flat desert landscape along with the **wide shoulders** and the often faded road lines. The weather is usually somewhat cloudy.
text_zh: 這段長距離的 31 號公路可以透過淺色的平坦沙漠景觀以及**寬路肩**和經常褪色的道路標線來識別。天氣通常有點多雲。

text: The divided section of Road 31 is the only divided road going through a flat desert landscape.
text_zh: 31 號公路的分隔車道段是穿過平坦沙漠景觀中唯一的雙向分隔道路。

text: Road 32 north of Duqm travels through a **hilly **desert landscape, in a general northern direction.
text_zh: 杜庫姆（Duqm）北側的 32 號公路穿過**丘陵**沙漠景觀，大致朝北方行進。

text: Crossing into the Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate, the shoulders become **wide**, like those on Road 31. However, unlike Road 31, the desert here is darker and has more shrubs and greenery. A long portion of the road also has overcast coverage. The lighter red section is no longer road 32 but still features the wide shoulders. The landscape further north also gets [hillier](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6) and more vegetated.
text_zh: 進入沙奇亞北省（Ash Sharqiyah North Governorate），路肩變得跟 31 號公路一樣**寬**。然而，與 31 號公路不同的是，這裡的沙漠顏色更深，且有更多灌木和綠色植物。道路很長的一部分也有陰天覆蓋。較淺的紅色路段已不再是 32 號公路，但仍保有寬路肩。更北方的景觀也變得更[多山丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/4La4moT9kWDS1Xbq6)且植被更豐富。

text: Road 35 is surrounded by hills and mountains, and the ground is mostly **covered in green shrubs. **Curved lamp posts are posted at regular intervals on the northeastern side of the road.
text_zh: 35 號公路周圍環繞著丘陵和山脈，地面大多**覆蓋著綠色灌木。**道路東北側固定間距設有彎曲的路燈桿。

text: Road 37 travels in a generally northwest direction through a very generic, flat desert landscape. The angle is one of the best clues for this road. On the southern half, a [big power line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8) is visible to the northeast, while on the northern half, you can find distinct [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A).
text_zh: 37 號公路大致呈西北走向，穿過非常平淡、平坦的沙漠景觀。角度是這條道路最好的線索之一。在南半部，東北方可見[大型輸電線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UwJ6ZDLboH1MJNpf8)；而在北半部，則可以找到明顯的[日落街景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/2Y2gJq7uQW76wV25A)。

text: Road 39 is also one of the more generic roads. Probably the best way to recognise it are the **narrow**, or even **non-existent shoulders**. The western parts can get quite [hilly](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316), but overall, the desert landscape is flat.
text_zh: 39 號公路也是比較大眾化的道路之一。辨識它最好的方法可能就是**狹窄**、甚至**幾乎沒有路肩**。西半部可能會變得蠻[多山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dgwhWhWKFo1RSK316)的，但整體而言，沙漠景觀是平坦的。

text: Coastal Road 41 features one of the sandiest landscapes in Oman, with very light sand all around. [The coast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RcScJcKptXEZAhNL7) is sometimes visible in the distance. On the north-to-south stretch, you can see a [distant ridge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icj21WV3ryenZhYY6) to the west.
text_zh: 沿海的 41 號公路擁有阿曼最沙質的景觀之一，周圍都是非常淺色的沙子。遠處有時可以看到[海岸](https://maps.app.goo.gl/RcScJcKptXEZAhNL7)。在由北向南的延伸路段，你可以看到西方有一道[遠處的山脊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/icj21WV3ryenZhYY6)。

text: The western stretch of Road 41 has wide shoulders similar to Road 31, however, the more northwest-bound angle along with the reddish soil should tell them apart. The eastern half has [cloudy coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K7CsRETLdzj2r132A).
text_zh: 41 號公路的西部路段有著類似 31 號公路的寬闊路肩，然而，其較偏西北走向的角度以及帶點紅色的土壤應該能幫你區分它們。東半部則有[多雲的街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/K7CsRETLdzj2r132A)。

text: Road 42/49 east of Salalah is a scenic coastal road that features a lot of** light-coloured tall rocky cliffs**. The coast is also often visible.
text_zh: 塞拉萊（Salalah）以東的 42/49 號公路是一條風景優美的沿海公路，有著許多**淺色高聳的岩石懸崖**。也經常可以看到海岸。

text: Just south of Shalim, you’ll find a stretch of** overcast** coverage, along with a power line to the west of the road, but only north of the [plateau](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nCyXdi6WiQmWz4Hn9).
text_zh: 就在沙利姆（Shalim）南方，你會發現一段 **陰天** 的街景覆蓋，道路西側有一條電線，但僅限於[高原](https://maps.app.goo.gl/nCyXdi6WiQmWz4Hn9)以北。

text: North of Shalim Road 42 turns into a **very wide unpaved road**, with the soil being quite light in colour. You’ll sometimes see [oil drills](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vy5T1HBJsQSKUwsRA) in the distance along this stretch.
text_zh: 沙利姆路 42 號以北會變成一條 **非常寬的未鋪 asfalt 道路**（未鋪柏油路），土壤顏色相當淺。沿著這段路，有時你會在遠處看到[石油鑽塔](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Vy5T1HBJsQSKUwsRA)。

text: The road southeast of Ubar has a general northwest bound angle, along with a power line to the left of the road. You will often see signs of life in the form of farms or buildings on this road.

NOTE: Don’t mix this up with the 37, which has a similar angle, but is [more desolate](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7) and can have [sunset coverage](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9).
text_zh: 烏巴爾（Ubar）東南方的道路大致呈西北走向，道路左側有一條電線。在這條路上，你經常會看到農場或建築物等有人居住的跡象。
注意：不要把這條路跟 37 號公路搞混了，37 號公路的角度相似，但[更為荒涼](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8uU7Jw947G7wktyd7)，且可能帶有[日落街景覆蓋](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dD63F9RyzyfugxBw9)。

text: Road 43, also south of Ubar, is unpaved and features** sunset coverage** along with a dust trail behind the car.
text_zh: 43 號公路同樣位於烏巴爾以南，是一條未鋪柏油路，並帶有 **日落街景覆蓋** 以及車輛後方揚起的塵土痕跡。

text: The unlabelled road northwest of Ubar can be recognised by the [small white markings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bGQBP9kQoM3H3R4GA) between the dashes.
text_zh: 烏巴爾（Ubar）西北方未標示名稱的道路，可以透過虛線之間的[白色小標記](https://maps.app.goo.gl/bGQBP9kQoM3H3R4GA)來辨識。

text: Just west of ميتان, only labelled in Arabic on Google Maps, literally translating to methane, there is a stretch of road, which has a uniquely light-coloured pavement. To the north, you can see [sand dunes](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9).
text_zh: 就在米坦（ميتان，在 Google 地圖上僅有阿拉伯文標示，直譯為甲烷）的正西方，有一段路面顏色獨特較淺的道路。往北看可以看到[沙丘](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EHoRRV2ud19p4Jbz9)。

text: Roads 45 and the western stretch of 39 both feature a similar slightly hilly desert landscape, sunny weather, and a general east-to-west direction. What makes them unique is the** **[**light-coloured shoulders**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)** **the roads share, though it is most pronounced on Road 45. The roads also mostly have a [faded white middle line](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8). To tell the 45 and western 39 apart, look at the sun, which is [overhead](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A) on the 39, but [to the west](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8) on 45. The section north of Mudayy is also the 45, but unlabelled on Google Maps.
text_zh: 45 號公路與 39 公路的西部路段都具有類似的微丘陵沙漠景觀、晴朗的天氣，且大致呈東西走向。它們的獨特之處在於兩條路都有**[淺色路肩](https://maps.app.goo.gl/81QXr1cqJT9yxvG17)**，不過在 45 號公路上最為明顯。這些道路也大多有[褪色的白色中線](https://maps.app.goo.gl/EiBMQQ3bh6DXt6HF8)。要分辨 45 號和西部 39 號公路，可以看太陽的位置：在 39 號公路上太陽在[正上方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/U4JtWs2nAKVCEvs7A)，但在 45 號公路上則在[西方](https://maps.app.goo.gl/MGzB83ntBRbf7KCG8)。穆代伊（Mudayy）以北的路段也是 45 號公路，但在 Google 地圖上未標示名稱。
